data.name: Fasiq
data.gender_notes: Fasiq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ‘fasaka’ which means ‘to rebel, disobey or break a rule’. In Islamic tradition, it is often used as a reminder of the consequences of disobedience to Allah and His commandments. The name Fasiq carries the meaning “Rebel, disobedient” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fasiq usually hope their child will grow to embody rebel, disobedient and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the importance of following the right path and seeking knowledge and guidance from the divine.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fasiq total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
